title: Specific Relief Act, 1963 — interplay with contract claims

content.overview: Specific performance is the primary remedy where the statute so provides. After the 2018 amendments, section 10 SRA directs specific performance subject to limited exceptions in ss. 11(2), 14, and 16. Section 20A restricts injunctions that impede infrastructure projects.

sections.heading: Post-2018 regime
sections.body: Specific performance is the rule subject to stated exceptions. Readiness and willingness under s. 16 remain essential. Personal service and continuous-supervision contracts are classic exclusions under s. 14.

sections.heading: Substituted performance
sections.body: Section 20 SRA allows substituted performance through a third party at the defaulting party's cost in appropriate cases.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Plead the contract, breach, readiness and willingness, and any infrastructure injunction bar under s. 20A. Align limitation and court fees with the specific-relief framing.

illustrations: A contractor seeks specific performance of a contract that falls within a statutory exclusion under section 14; the court must apply the exclusion rather than assume specific performance is available merely because a contract exists.

enhancement.detailedExplanation:
India Code rule: The Specific Relief Act, 1963 provides the statutory framework for specific performance and related injunctions. Section 10 makes specific performance enforceable subject to the Act; sections 11(2), 14 and 16 state statutory limits and personal bars; section 20A imposes special restrictions concerning infrastructure projects.

Definition: Specific relief in contract disputes is relief compelling performance or granting the statutory form of equitable protection rather than merely awarding damages, subject to the Specific Relief Act’s conditions and bars.

Ingredients:
1. Identify an enforceable contract and the relief sought.
2. Apply section 10 and the statutory exceptions or bars.
3. Test section 16 personal bars where the claimant seeks specific performance.
4. Check section 14 for contracts excluded from specific performance.
5. For infrastructure projects, apply section 20A before seeking a prohibitory injunction.
